reason: Both are building-products manufacturers selling through distributors and contractors into commercial construction. Carlisle's products are roofing, insulation and waterproofing for the building envelope. SPX's products are HVAC equipment (cooling towers, boilers, electric heat, fans) plus detection and measurement systems. Carlisle also has HVAC-related brands, but they are a small part of its business. The customer overlap is partial (commercial building owners and contractors), and the products are mostly different. SPX's detection and measurement segment sells to utilities, transit agencies and government, which Carlisle does not serve. So this is adjacent, not a direct peer.
